column1: # PopLDdecay2 expected-output fixtures -- CI regression gate.
# PopLDdecay 3.45 is not redistributable, so CI cannot re-run it. These
# digests come from the current implementation, whose byte-for-byte equality
# with PopLDdecay 3.45 over the same case matrix is verified separately by
# golden_diff.sh. Regenerate the fixtures whenever an output format
# changes *intentionally*, and record why in the commit message.
